from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u012/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != background}
    if not markers:
        return out
    marker = next(iter(markers))
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(height):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(width):
        positions = [r for r in range(height) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
